commands.name: search-packages
commands.summary: Search JSR packages by keyword, or list all packages when no query is given (public management API)

commands.name: search-packages-by-runtime
commands.summary: Full-text package search with an optional runtime-compatibility filter, using the site's Algolia autocomplete index

commands.name: get-package
commands.summary: Get metadata for one package: description, latest version, score, runtime compatibility, GitHub repo

commands.name: get-package-meta
commands.summary: Registry meta.json for a package: latest version and the map of all versions (with yanked flags)

commands.name: list-package-dependencies
commands.summary: List the dependencies (jsr:/npm: specifiers and version constraints) of a specific package version

commands.name: list-package-dependents
commands.summary: List packages that depend on a given package

commands.name: get-package-score
commands.summary: Get the JSR score breakdown for a package: readme, docs coverage, fast check, provenance, runtime compat

commands.name: get-package-docs-index
commands.summary: Get the structured docs index of a package version: entrypoints, module docs and their symbols (used for symbol search)

commands.name: list-package-files
commands.summary: List the files of a package version (path, size, checksum) and its exports map, from the registry version metadata

commands.name: get-package-file
commands.summary: Get the raw source of one file in a package version, e.g. deno.json or mod.ts

commands.name: get-scope
commands.summary: Get public info about a scope (creator, creation date, publishing settings)

commands.name: list-scope-packages
commands.summary: List all packages published in a scope

commands.name: list-scope-members
commands.summary: List the members of a scope with their roles and user profile links

commands.name: list-user-packages
commands.summary: List packages a JSR user recently published (user id is the UUID from a /user/{id} link)

commands.name: get-registry-stats
commands.summary: Get the homepage lists: newest packages, recently updated package versions and featured packages

dropped.name: list-package-versions
dropped.reason: Output was {}: the response shape does not match the defaultFields or array assumption, so the version list is not produced. get-package-meta already gives every version with createdAt and yanked flags.
